_comment: Shared by explorer.html and the Python API. dataBase: folder with one subfolder per threshold, each holding matrix.csv (tract x topic decoding, joint LPI + RAS), matrix_RAS.csv / matrix_LPI.csv (each endpoint on its own) and cluster-matrix.csv (cluster x topic). surfMeshBase: fsaverage midthickness mesh (+ cortex mask + thickness) the func.gii endpoint maps were made on. topicTermsUrl: full LDA term list per topic (scripts/export_topic_terms.py). thresholds: label -> {folder: subfolder of dataBase; surfBase: per-tract endpoint maps '{lh|rh}.{tract}.{LPI|RAS}.func.gii' (omit to hide 3D maps); cut: dendrogram distance cut for live clustering; noClusters: true hides the Cluster step; value: numeric threshold}. Labels show complete tracts in the dendrogram / map-complete cohort size.
